observations: Photo 0: Silver-and-black retro SLR-style camera body with rear body cap reading 'Nikon Z mount'; 'Z fc' badge visible on top plate.
Photo 1: Close-up of top dials (ISO dial, shutter dial) and 'Z fc' engraving; a manual-focus lens is mounted, showing aperture/distance scales in white markings, no autofocus contacts visible.

Photo 2: Top-down flat-lay showing the camera body with lens attached, a Nikon-branded rechargeable battery, a Nikon battery charger, two rear lens caps, and a front lens cap printed 'TTArtisan APS-C 25mm F2.0'.
No photo shows the rear LCD/EVF screen powered on, no sensor shot, no image sample, no shutter-count screen, no memory card or box.

response.reason: The body (Nikon Z fc) and lens (TTArtisan 25mm F2.0) are clearly identifiable from the photos, but no proof of power-on, screen condition, shutter count, or lens glass clarity is shown, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
